payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP on values: dp[v] = count[v] + max(dp[d]) for d dividing v. Implemented via sieve: for each k, propagate dp[k] to multiples i=2k,3k,... by max update, then add count[i] later.
payload.rationale: The solution maintains a 1D DP array where state is the value. It iteratively computes the longest chain of numbers where each divides the next, using divisor-to-multiple updates. This matches dp_1d_state; no tree or 2D structure present.
